title: Modules courbes elliptiques en caractéristiques ≠2 : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page continues Grothendieck's elementary study of the automorphism group of a 'square' (carré) Q = (S, A, R). Here S is a 4-element set of vertices, A a 4-element set of edges, and R ⊂ S×A the incidence relation. The group 𝒟 = Aut Q is dihedral of order 8.

He records its internal structure in canonical, choice-free terms:
- The centre has order 2. Its nontrivial element is the 'antipodism' a (rotation by π). Earlier, a fixed-point-free involution a was used to form C = A/a (pairs of opposite edges) and D = S/a (the two diagonals).
- 𝒟 has exactly two elements u, u' = u^{-1} of order 4. They generate the unique cyclic subgroup 𝒟⁺ (the rotations), which is the group Γ ('c'est bien Γ').
- S and A are 𝒟⁺-torsors ('losanges sous 𝒟⁺').
- The antipodism is the unique involution in 𝒟⁺.
- 𝒟 has three index-2 subgroups: V_S, 𝒟⁺ and V_A. V_S ≅ F_2^C and V_A ≅ F_2^D are the two Klein four-groups (V_S is the inverse image of the Sylow/Klein subgroup of 𝔖_S, and similarly V_A).
- Each quotient 𝒟/V_S ≅ Z/2 acts on V_S by conjugation. The action fixes {1,a} ≅ F_2 and swaps the two reflections, i.e. it acts as the transposition on V_S∖{1,a} ≅ C. Symmetrically for V_A and D.
- 𝒟/𝒟⁺ ≅ Z/2 acts on 𝒟⁺ by inversion x ↦ x^{-1}. This is the transposition of the 2-element set ω_Q of generators of 𝒟⁺, the set of 'orientations' of the square.
- For c ∈ C (reflections in V_S) and d ∈ D (reflections in V_A), the commutator [c,d] = a.
- 𝒟_ab = 𝒟/{1,a} is a rank-2 F_2-vector space. Via the action of 𝒟 on C and on D, it is canonically 𝔖_C × 𝔖_D ≅ F_2 × F_2 ≅ V_S/F_2 × V_A/F_2. Its three lines correspond to V_S, V_A and 𝒟⁺, and the latter corresponds to the diagonal (continued on the next page).

Purpose: this is bookkeeping toward describing level structures on elliptic curves. Plausibly these are Z/4-type structures, or 'square' structures on 4-element sets such as the points of order 2 or 4. The aim seems to be a choice-free identification of the several equivalent descriptions of a 'square' structure (via S, A, C, D, torsors under Γ) and of their automorphism group, presumably for descent/forms (twisted forms of Z/4Z) over a base in characteristic ≠ 2.
errors: The notation 𝒟⁺_ab is used where 𝒟_ab = 𝒟/{1,a} (the abelianization of the full dihedral group) is meant. 𝒟⁺ is cyclic of order 4, so its abelianization is itself, not F_2×F_2. This is a slip, partly corrected in the margin '𝒟_ab ≃ 𝒟/{1,a}'.
Next page: 'les 3 éléments de 𝒟⁺ sont d'ordre 4' should be the 2 elements of 𝒟⁺∖{1,a} (the set ω_Q). The decomposition 𝒟 = {1}⊔{a}⊔C⊔D⊔ω_Q into 5 conjugacy classes is correct.
Otherwise correct. In particular [c,d] = (cd)^2 = a, since cd is a rotation of order 4.

ideas.what: Canonical description of subgroup lattice, centre, and conjugation actions of D_4 = Aut(square) in terms of the sets C (pairs of opposite edges), D (diagonals), and ω_Q (orientations)
ideas.modern_name: Structure of the dihedral group of order 8; Klein four-subgroups; abelianization D_4/Z ≅ (Z/2)^2

ideas.what: Viewing S, A as torsors under the cyclic group 𝒟⁺ ≅ Γ (a form of Z/4Z), giving equivalent descriptions of 'square' structures
ideas.modern_name: Torsors / twisted forms; D_4 = Aut(Z/4Z-torsor with orientation reversal) = Z/4 ⋊ Z/2

deep.surprise_reason: This is entirely routine finite group theory (the subgroup lattice of D_4), written canonically as is typical for Grothendieck. It is preparatory bookkeeping for level structures on elliptic curves and contains nothing new.
transcription_corrections: '𝒟⁺_ab ≃ 𝒟/{1,a}' should read 𝒟_ab ≃ 𝒟/{1,a}, the abelianization of 𝒟, not of 𝒟⁺.
Margin line '𝒟⁺ ≃ Z/4Z^∧_{±1} ω_Q' likely means 𝒟⁺ ≃ Z/4Z ∧^{±1} ω_Q, i.e. 𝒟⁺ is the twist of Z/4Z by the {±1}-torsor ω_Q of orientations.
The insertion over the 'On a fixé C, D' line reads roughly: 'et à travers 𝒟/{1,a}, 𝒟 opère sur C, 𝒟 opère sur D, i.e. c∈C, d∈D ⇒ [c,d]=a'.
